tool_args.prompt: Create one complete full-body transparent-background image of Meset from Resident Evil 6 (2012), using BOTH attached original-game references together. The light-background render shows the character's surface and visible joint/appendage layout but crops one wing tip; the dark in-game figurine screenshot supplies the COMPLETE two-wing silhouette including both outer tips and the complete lower appendages. Produce exactly one Meset in its airborne wings-spread form. Preserve TWO feathered dark wings with irregular tattered vanes, the long low avian/reptilian head, compact organic thorax, the visible arrangement of bent long hook-bearing lateral appendages and the TWO hanging clawed feet (one foot is partly obscured behind the other in the sources). Reproduce the visible paths and bends of the hooked appendages from the two sources; their roots overlap near the thorax and must remain naturally hidden. Do NOT infer a new exact limb count from each visible hook, branch a new limb, or add a duplicate hook to make the silhouette symmetric. No bat membranes, new tail, rider, captive, human, extra wing, new feather crest or replaced talons. Generate a physically turned but still FRONT three-quarter airborne pose facing SCREEN-LEFT, with the long head oriented left and the chest turned only modestly so the reference hook-root occlusions stay natural. The anatomical LEFT side is nearer the viewer. Both wings extend upward/outward in a restrained spread; the far wing may overlap behind the near one but BOTH wing tips remain inside the canvas. All visible lateral hooks and both clawed feet must remain completely inside the image. Preserve asymmetrical wear on the correct side. This is an independent pose, never a software flip. No game viewer cage, lights, circular plinth or dark screenshot backdrop. Preserve the original game's textured rendered appearance; do not redesign the subject or claim a native model. Fit the ENTIRE single creature and all wing/hook/hand/foot/tail/device endpoints inside the canvas with at least TEN PERCENT empty transparent margin on EVERY side of its combined silhouette. Scale the whole subject down to fit. True RGBA transparency, no ground shadow, floor, backdrop, fog, glow, border, logo, text, watermark, second subject or sprite sheet. This is a generated static visual candidate with inferred hidden surfaces, not certified one-to-one geometry or an animation.
